Class multiplayerState

java.lang.Object
ass2.ass2_jfx.controller.multiplayerState
public class multiplayerState extends Object
Shared state container for an active multiplayer session. Implements the Singleton pattern to provide a single source of truth for the client, server, and player name across the lobby and play screens. The server field is only set when this player is the host. If the player joined someone else's game, server will be null.
Version:
Java 21
Author:
Shane O'Connell, Joshua MacPherson
